records.definition: Not eddy diameter. Parallel arc at contour bounding-box midlatitude.
records.scope: One closed source-figure contour during the publication-scoped Ursa shedding event; physical attribution remains pending.
records.qualification: Editorial candidate map span, not a physical whole-ring dimension. Four accepted stroke/threshold cases and 17 axis calibrations each, plus six-pixel allowance at each extent; outward 25 km rounding. Linear source-axis calibration throughout the panel ROI, including below the lowest labeled latitude tick. Reading sensitivity is not instrument error, statistical confidence or seasonal variability. Source literal SSH contour 0.65 cm has unresolved unit; no silent conversion to metres. No geometry admission, lifetime, state containment, registry crosswalk or seasonal playback inferred.
